name: It Was Always Going to Happen

description.value:
Range 60 feet

Targets 1 creature

Frequency once per day

Saving Throw Will

Mark a target for three escalating hits of mental damage.

The target must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or be marked for the rest of the encounter: the next three times it takes damage from any source, each instance is increased by @Damage[4d6[mental]] damage (@Damage[6d6[mental]] on a critical failure). On a success, only the next such instance is increased, by @Damage[4d6[mental]].
